sentences.text: Hmph. Luna, I reviewed the sensor data, and I see no evidence of any paranormal activity.
Instead, the appliance energy registered a significant spike, observing 380 Wh between 05:40 and 05:50.
This observed value is much higher than the expected 52 Wh, suggesting that the machines were simply waking up.
It is probably just the house getting ready for the day, not some spooky presence.
